content:
Amazon and Best Buy's Labor Day sales continue, with AirPods Pro 3 dropping another $50 and AirTag 2 hitting an all-time low of $20 each. But today's 9to5Toys mid-day flash focuses on the 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR hitting a new all-time low of $329 off on Amazon (up to $500 off via the Apple Refurbished Store), plus the lowest price yet on the latest iPad Air at $100 off. We also have launch deals on Anker's all-new MagGo 2 Pro Qi2.2 power bank with smart display, and Powerbeats Pro 2 with Find My and heart rate tracking down up to $92. Keep reading for all the details.

Amazon's 2026 Labor Day mega sale is live: thousands of deals across Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, even deals under $5

Best Buy's 2026 Labor Day sale is live: Apple, Android phones, home appliances up to $1,100 off, TVs & more

AirPods Pro 3 down to $50 off in Amazon's Labor Day sale

Amazon's Labor Day sale is live, bringing Apple's latest AirPods Pro 3 down to $199 shipped.

Amazon is now selling the latest flagship AirPods Pro 3 for $199 — that's $50 off direct and the lowest price available on a brand new set.

Apple's 2026 Studio Display XDR hits new all-time low $329 off, $500 off on refurbished models

After briefly hitting an all-time low on the standard model, Amazon is now selling the 2026 Apple Studio Display XDR for $329 off at the lowest price ever. Amazon is also offering the lowest price on the Apple Studio Display right now, down nearly $100 (just a few dollars shy of its all-time low).

Amazon is now selling the Apple Studio Display XDR with tilt and height-adjustable stand for $2,969.99 shipped.

This $3,299 flagship Apple display is now down to the lowest price we've tracked.

Worth noting, the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is selling the same model right now for $2,799 shipped — $500 off the original price, which is a very compelling price. However, that's only $171 less than a brand new unit over at Amazon — not an insignificant amount, but worth considering when you're already spending this much.

Apple deals are winding down, snag AirTag 2 at all-time low ($20 each) while you can

  • AirTag 2 for $24 (reg. $29) — back to all-time low
  • AirTag 2 4-pack for $80 (reg. $99) — brand new all-time low

Amazon's lowest price yet on the latest iPad Air is $100 off, other models up to $149 off

Amazon's ongoing Labor Day sale has multiple discounts on the latest M4 iPad Air lineup. The one catching my eye is the cheapest model in the lineup, now down $100.

Amazon is now selling the 128GB 11-inch M4 iPad Air for $649 shipped.

That's $100 off the original $749 price and the lowest we've found. There was a brief flash deal that was a bit lower (it didn't last an hour), but this is the lowest the cheapest model in the lineup has been in the last two months.

Another Labor Day deal worth noting is the 1TB 13-inch M4 iPad Air. It's clearly much more expensive, but it's now $149 off — dropping from the original $1,549 down to $1,399.99 shipped.

Some other configurations are also seeing solid discounts right now:

M4 iPad Air 11-inch

  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB for $650 (reg. $749)
  • 11-inch M4 iPad Air 512GB for $949 (reg. $1,049)

M4 iPad Air 13-inch

  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 128GB for $850 (reg. $949)
  • 13-inch M4 iPad Air 256GB for $950 (reg. $1,049)

Sony's 2026 BRAVIA 7 II HDR TV is $800 off for Labor Day

Sony.com is also running solid Labor Day deals right now, headlined by some 2026 BRAVIA TVs. Beyond deals on the latest headphones, DSLR/mirrorless cameras and more, we're also seeing up to $800 off the latest 2026 BRAVIA 7 II and BRAVIA 8 II smart TVs.

  • BRAVIA 7 II 65-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini for $1,800 (reg. $2,600)

More Sony Labor Day TV deals still live:

  • BRAVIA 7 II 50-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini for $1,400 (reg. $1,600)
  • BRAVIA 7 II 55-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini for $1,500 (reg. $2,100)
  • BRAVIA 7 II 75-inch RGB 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini for $2,300 (reg. $3,100)
  • BRAVIA 8 II 55-inch QD-OLED 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini for $2,000 (reg. $2,600)
  • BRAVIA 8 II 65-inch QD-OLED 4K HDR Google TV with Gemini for $2,500 (reg. $3,300)

Anker debuts all-new smart display charger lineup at IFA with battery safety device identification [Launch deals]

Anker's all-new MagGo 2 Pro Qi2.2 power bank with smart display and cooling fan lands with launch deals, free MagSafe wallet

M6 Mac mini preorder deals start at Amazon, shipping this month

With Best Buy and Amazon's Labor Day sales now live, the shipping dates for the new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro models are also right around the corner. If you're still considering preordering, don't miss out on the brand new Apple Polishing Cloth for just $9 (could sell out at any time), and check out the discounts Amazon is offering on Apple's new Mac mini preorders.

We previously covered the deals going live separately, but wanted to gather them in one place for those still considering preorders ahead of this month's ship dates:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB for $880 (reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB for $1,070 (reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB for $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB for $1,669 (reg. $1,699)

Powerbeats Pro 2 with Find My, heart rate tracking & more down up to $92

With Amazon and Best Buy's Labor Day mega sales now live, alongside $50 off AirPods Pro 3, the latest Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 are also $50 off. Through Best Buy's 'Excellent' open-box stock, you can save even more ($92 off).

Amazon is now selling the Jet Black Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 noise-cancelling earbuds with Find My and heart rate tracking for $199.95 shipped.

That's $50 off the original $250 price, matching the deal we reported on previously and just $20 shy of its all-time low. Same $50 markdown as Apple's latest flagship AirPods Pro 3.

However, if you want to grab them for even less, Best Buy's 'Excellent' open-box stock is now just $157.99 shipped — $92 below the new retail price, the lowest price from a reputable retailer.

  • Fully functional like new
  • Cosmetically like new
  • Includes all accessories
  • Packaging may differ or may not be present

Yes, you can get $1 more off the AirPods Pro 3 right now, but if you're looking for something with more of a sporty edge, the Powerbeats Pro 2 have the better deal going. They feature Fit Earhooks for a more secure fit for runners and high-intensity workout enthusiasts, up to 45 hours of battery life, built-in Apple Find My, ANC to keep you focused on your workout, and full compatibility with both Apple and Android devices:
